commits.message: OrientDB prepare for next development iteration

Fix scheduling of task in past

Corrects refactoring in 1b9cbe2e0cf58bc966b5a29acb2cc5ccff7d5fab to make scheduling a task for a past date consistent with the TimerTask API and execute with no delay.

Correct records size after update and delete.

Correctly calculate records size for a cluster on update and delete, adjusting for cluster and chunk entry overheads, and allowing multi-chunk records.
Add checks for record size to all cluster ITs, implemented for V2 and left as a TODO for V0/V1 (which are either incorrect or have a different interpretation of records size).
fix: changed static thread local allocation after recent failures
chore: upated maven central plugin
fix: correct the use of serializer in network message, issue #10585

Signed-off-by: dependabot[bot] <support@github.com>
fix: exclude flb file from backup

Fix CWE-470 unsafe reflection in ORecordSerializerNetworkV37

The binary network record deserializer resolved and instantiated an
arbitrary, attacker-named class from the wire via
Class.forName(name).newInstance() in both the EMBEDDED and CUSTOM
branches, running the class static initializer and no-arg constructor
before any type check and before the request's session token is
validated. A network peer reaching the binary protocol port could
trigger arbitrary classpath-class instantiation pre-authentication
(deserialization-gadget RCE primitive).

Resolve the class without initialization (Class.forName(name, false,
loader)) and verify membership (isAssignableFrom against
ODocumentSerializable / OSerializableStream) before instantiation, so a
class that does not implement the expected serialization interface is
rejected before its static initializer or constructor can run.
chore:fix formatting
fix: handled additional cases of ODocumentSerializable
fix: handled additional cases of OStreamSerializable
